newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil premiums stay weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil premiums stay weak.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil premiums to formulae of published quotes remained weak on Tuesday and supply was still good, traders said.
An ARA player was heard to have bought a mixed M40/E4 cargo at no premium to the mean/mean/mean of published quotes.
These follow E-4 deals heard done on Friday and Monday at discounts of between 50 cents and $2 to the m/m/m of quotes.
While some dealers felt plentiful cargoes in northwest Europe were theoretically able to move into the Mediterranean, others said that backwardation in the Med market would make such sales difficult.
